info.description:
Generated deterministically from the Step 1 (task analysis), Step 2 (API discovery and mapping) and Step 3 (scenario and dependency analysis) results.

Request hosts are {{base_url}} or {{base_url_vdi}}; their values come from the Postman environment (run with --environment), not from this collection.
